name: phonelink-signed-app
description: PhoneLink serves its app from the computer and the phone checks the computer's signature before running any page code. Runs the unit tests for the signature, a tampered bundle and last-seen, the phone-side verifier's tests, confirms the built loader a directory serves carries no app code, and (when Chromium is installed) drives the real loader in a browser against a scratch relay and PhoneLink host on scratch ports and a scratch HOME.

steps.title: The computer signs the app and a tampered bundle is refused

steps.command: PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_phone_link_app.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3; echo PY_DONE
steps.description: Run the host-side signature and last-seen tests

steps.command: (cd packages/kollabor-webui/frontend && node --test tests/phone-app-verify.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E '^ℹ (pass|fail)'); echo JS_DONE

steps.description: phone-side verifier refuses every tampered case

steps.title: The directory-served loader carries no app code

steps.command: d=packages/kollabor-webui/frontend/dist/phonelink; if [ -f $d/loader/loader.js ] && [ ! -e $d/loader/phone-app.js.gz ] && [ -f $d/app/phone-app.js.gz ]; then echo LOADER_ONLY_OK; else echo LOADER_ONLY_FAIL; fi
steps.description: Loader dir has loader.js and no app; app dir has the app
the relay-served directory holds only the loader

steps.title: Real browser, scratch ports, scratch HOME

steps.command: (cd packages/kollabor-webui/frontend && PATH="$PWD/../../../.venv/bin:$PATH" timeout 110 node tests/phonelink-browser-e2e.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E 'PASS|Error' | head -3); echo E2E_DONE
steps.description: Pair, load the signed app, relaunch, and refuse a tampered copy in Chromium
